description: Defines the interface StatisticsConfig for configuring statistics actor settings, including timeouts, intervals, shard configurations, and a factory method for instantiation based on actor context.

classes.name: StatisticsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the statistics actor, including methods to retrieve timeouts, intervals, shard configs, and a static factory method.

classes.name: StatisticsConfig.ConfigValues
classes.description: Enum implementing KnownConfigValue, defining configuration keys and default values for ask timeout, update interval, details expiry, and shards.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout for asking other cluster members.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for updating public statistics.

methods.name: getDetailsExpireAfter
methods.description: Returns the lifetime of statistics details.

methods.name: getShards
methods.description: Returns the list of shard configurations for reporting statistics.

methods.name: forActor
methods.description: Creates a StatisticsConfig instance based on the actor system's configuration, using the provided ActorContext.
